finding: cluster6_01_crowd: hour-bounded 0.1 round window welds honest senders to the 0.1 farm

verdict.mechanism_claim: CONFIRMED exactly from cache + sybilkit code (signals/__init__.py MAX_HOUR_GAP=1, chain edges between consecutive rows).
verdict.headline_count: OVERSTATED: title says ~150 honest; the window bridge accounts for 116 early/late exact-0.1 senders (115 at h0-16/h22-23 + 1 at h17) of which fresh on-chain sampling puts ~85% human-like; the proposed fix releases 100 from cluster 6 of which ~80-85 look honest and ~10-15 are burners / small multi-wallet groups (<=5 wallets each).
verdict.fix_claim: NOT SAFE AS STATED: the 32-block rule also releases 233 nonce-0 wallets funded by Bitget hot wallet 0x1ab4973a (amounts 1.19-1.69, one priority fee 0.01 gwei, gas limit 91462/91600, h17-31), 12 of the 98.5-ETH ring (nonce0 7/12) and 10 of a 2.6/2.7 group (nonce0 6/10) - farm-like by the evidence standard; these are 30% of the 832 released population-wide. The 5099/5099 and 141/141 retention figures are true but do not cover those groups (they were never in the v1 >=100 list / labeled set).

Mini-groups found: hub 0xa1abfa21 (9 funded wallets, heterogeneous amounts 0.05-1.0, 2 released) and the 0.099 h12 trio (3 fresh wallets each funded ~0.0995 by a different exchange-scale EOA 1-3 min before, all released)

alternative_explanations_checked.aged_wallets_bought_or_reused_by_the_0.1: REJECTED for the bulk: 57 distinct priority fees, 11 gas limits, 114/115 type-2 txs vs the operator core (type-0, gas 91600, no tip, peel-funded 290/321); 0 shared non-infra funders between early band and core beyond exchange-scale EOAs (0x9696f59e x3, 0xbf94f0ac x3, 0x56eddb7a x2) which is not evidence; no shared post-game sweep targets in 20 fresh + 15 investigator samples
alternative_explanations_checked.early_band_is_one_hidden_operator: REJECTED: arrivals at background rate (median 21 blocks between consecutive early 0.1 senders, p90 113, max 294) with heterogeneous funders (83 distinct funders for 115 wallets); at most small groups of 2-9 wallets found (numeric-ENS peel chain of 8 at h11 - stays flagged under the fix; 0.11/0.12 identical-tip quintet at h10-11 - partly released; hub_9; 0.099 trio; 3-wallet 748-day group)
alternative_explanations_checked.the_hour_rule_is_catching_something_the_: CONFIRMED and material: the same hour-window rule is what holds the 233 Bitget-funded staggered wallets together (47 x 1.69 over h21-30 etc. with avg gap ~64 blocks); reverting to 32 blocks loses them

strongest_supported_claim: The MAX_HOUR_GAP=1 windowing makes 0.1 ETH (the most popular human amount, sent continuously at ~7/hour for 24 h) one 545-wallet window; its chain edges are the only tier-A link between the 321-wallet legacy 0.1 farm core and 224 other exact-0.1 senders; 116 of those (h0-16/h22-23, 86 nonce>=20, 38 ENS, 57 distinct tips) are a mixed human crowd of which ~85% look honest, i.e. ~95-100 honest wallets (not 150) are flagged only because of this welding. A block-gap rule for round amounts fixes cluster 6 (-100, identical list to the investigator) but is not acceptable population-wide without a guard for uniform-fingerprint windows (nonce-0 + single funder + single tip), because it releases 233 staggered Bitget-funded wallets, 12 ring-98.5 members and a 2.6/2.7 group.
